field_guide.primary_criterion: Owning catalog ID; related criteria are annotations, not repeated deductions
field_guide.action: Concrete repair, source inspection, or author decision
field_guide.owner: One editor or reviewer responsible for the next action
field_guide.affected_sections: Section IDs requiring reconciliation after the repair
field_guide.affected_roles: Reviewers needed for a fresh targeted verification round
field_guide.opened_round: Round where this finding was first observed; retain its stable finding ID
field_guide.resolution: Changed revision, observed repair and verification location; keep unresolved blockers open
field_guide.closure_evidence: Current input hashes, verification report path and exact observed repair; a higher score alone is insufficient
